{{Top}}
'''Durelium''' was a type of precious [[Ore/Legends|ore]] used in the construction of [[Starship/Legends|starships]] as part of the [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]].

==Usage==
Durelium was used in the construction of [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrives]]<ref name="P&P">''[[Pirates & Privateers]]''</ref> and was mined from the [[Tava Yagen]] [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid belt]].<ref name="CTD">''[[Cracken's Threat Dossier]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
Durelium was incorrectly spelled as "durellium" in ''[[Lords of the Expanse]]''.
